tailoring.headline: Senior Software Engineer – eCommerce Marketplace | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, Microservices
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale eCommerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, microservices, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, SQL performance tuning, and techno-functional analysis with agile international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer - eCommerce Marketplace
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join PAYBACK because its innovative marketplace platform aligns with my passion for building scalable eCommerce solutions. With over 5 years of hands-on experience on SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have delivered robust Java-Spring microservices and complex data integrations that drive marketplace growth.

bullets.label: Backend Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented core backend features on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java, Spring and Spring Boot, delivering high-performance product and catalog services.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM/ERP/MDM systems, ensuring seamless data flow across global eCommerce channels.

bullets.label: Data & Performance
bullets.text: Optimized SQL queries and refactored database access, reducing latency and supporting high-volume marketplace transactions.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Led code reviews, CI/CD deployments on CCv2, and collaborated with international stakeholders in Scrum teams to deliver releases on schedule.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026 – eager to discuss how I can contribute to PAYBACK.

tailoring.why_company: PAYBACK’s leading loyalty ecosystem and data-driven marketplace inspire me to create seamless shopping experiences for millions of users. I admire how PAYBACK combines retail insight with cutting-edge technology to boost merchant growth. My background in SAP Commerce Cloud, API-centric integrations and agile delivery equips me to enhance the platform’s scalability, performance and customer value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to accelerate PAYBACK’s marketplace growth and deliver innovative, high-performance eCommerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience. I’m eager to bring my Java-Spring expertise to PAYBACK’s eCommerce Marketplace. Could we discuss the Senior Software Engineer role?
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior Software Engineer eCommerce Marketplace
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Software Engineer – eCommerce Marketplace role at PAYBACK. With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep Java, Spring and integration expertise. I look forward to discussing how I can help drive PAYBACK’s marketplace growth.
